calendarNotes: The main 2025–26 SPS calendar has 171 student days. August 19 is also identified as the first day for Wonder Years and Early Childhood Special Education. Boyd, Field, and Rountree use the separate archived PYP calendar linked in Downloads. Parent/teacher conferences run October 20–31, but the PDF does not label that entire window as no school. Thanksgiving combines November 24–25 student break days with district closures November 26–28. Winter Break ends December 30, followed by a December 31 district closure, a January 1 district closure, and a January 2 professional day, so students return January 5. Spring Break runs March 16–19, while March 13 is a professional day and March 20 is district closed, creating student days off from March 13 through March 20. The PDF lists May 22 as the last day and as the end of its fourth-quarter range, while a separate sidebar prints May 23; this page uses May 22 and records the source discrepancy.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Springfield Public Schools start in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Students on the main SPS district calendar started Tuesday, August 19, 2025. The PDF also identifies this as the first day for Wonder Years and Early Childhood Special Education.

calendarFaqs.q: When did SPS students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22–30, 2025. December 31 and January 1 were district-closed dates, and January 2 was a professional day with students out, so students returned Monday, January 5, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: How long were SPS students out around Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Students were out March 13–20. March 13 was a professional day, Spring Break ran March 16–19, and March 20 was district closed. Students returned Monday, March 23.

calendarFaqs.q: Were students out for the entire October 20–31 conference window?
calendarFaqs.a: The annual PDF lists Parent/Teacher Conferences for October 20–31 but does not label the entire range as no school. October 17 was the professional day when students were out.

calendarFaqs.q: Which schools used the 2025–26 PYP calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Boyd, Field, and Rountree elementary schools used the separate archived SPS PYP calendar. Its dates are not included in the main district ICS.
